svg.title: Figure 3-SG-02-1. SG-02: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-02-1. SG-02: 27 events (backed 25, by design 1, external 3, unbacked 0); 38 FMEA modes reach SG-02 (in the tree 36, justified 2, tree gaps 0). Single points: BE-2.07: DFM-012, DFM-020, PFM-008, 4 causes, D 8–10, not detected. BE-2.01 (EPS drops LKA assistance (LKA fault state in 0x262)) → SFM-004: Insufficient lateral control (undershoot in curves, drift toward lane edge); worst cause SFM-004.C1 (Safety model torque limit below what the curve requires (by design); O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-7.20 ((diagnostic TX hook passes any ISO 15765 frame; as SG-07)): No FMEA row needed: by design; The ELM327 TX hook passes any ISO 15765 frame by design (SWF-015.C1); it is the standing condition under which BE-7.21 acts. BE-2.20 (SoC sends a diagnostic request that resets the EPS or opens a session on it while engaged (QM fault)) → SWF-015: Diagnostic (ELM327) mode accepted while driving; worst cause SWF-015.C1 (ELM327 TX hook allows any ISO 15765 diagnostic frame with no service, ignition or motion condition. BL-005, reference build (default): once TOYOTA has been accepted with the ignition on, ELM327 is refused until the ignition goes off (panda#16, LD-DES-001 DR-05, DFA DFI-08). Before the car mode in each ignition cycle (fingerprinting, radar disable), or for a whole drive in which the car mode is never set, the content is still unrestricted; O 4, D 8, AP H); detection: panda host tests test_elm327_refused_after_the_car_mode_while_ignition_on, test_elm327_allowed_again_after_ignition_off and test_refused_elm327_counted, run in CI (safety.yaml panda_host_tests). Targeted at the gate, not proven by mutation; nothing tests frame content BE-2.08 (EPS fault warned only by the host; after a steering override in the last 1.5 s or at standstill only a low-priority prompt, no soft disable or take-over alert, latched for the fault (car_events.py:171, events.py:516; not in the envelope, GAP-03). 2026-10-12, reference build: envelope refuses LKA torque on a fault code and reports epsFault (TSR-110), which no SoC process reads. After BL-005 (TSR-607 (b)/(c), DQ-342 A, DQ-366 A): the prompt lasts at most 1.5 s, then the take-over request; while the driver keeps steering, a prompt after 1.5 s (car_events.py:173-187)) → SFM-038, SWF-088: Warning of a lateral-control fault or limit late, not escalated or missing; worst cause SFM-038.C2 (pandad publishes the panda fields epsFault and requestsRejected (pandad.cc:137-138), but no SoC process reads them (txRateExceeded is read, TSR-615), so a panda-side EPS-fault refusal reaches the driver only through the panda siren and the stock EPS path (SW FMEA SWF-025 notes); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause UE-2.19 (EPS stops accepting LKA requests without a fault state in 0x262: neither the host nor the envelope sees it; no check of EPS acceptance against the command (SFM-005.C1; TSR-626, WP-A-03 OI-8)) → SFM-005: Loss of lateral control without driver alert; worst cause SFM-005.C3 (Process crash or hang not detected by liveness checks; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.12 (HMI hang: render loop or audio stream stalled while processes stay alive (processNotRunning covers crashes only)) → SFM-026, SWF-082: Takeover or disengagement alert not presented; worst cause SFM-026.C1 (UI process hung or display off; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.13 (Alert volume not audible (no defined minimum; FFI-CM-18)) → SFM-026: Takeover or disengagement alert not presented; worst cause SFM-026.C1 (UI process hung or display off; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.25 (Take-over alert masked by an alert of higher priority but lower urgency (SoftDisableAlert is Priority.MID; alertmanager.py:63)) → SWF-035, SFM-027: Takeover request masked by a lower-urgency alert; worst cause SFM-027.C1 (UI frame drops or audio buffering; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.14 (Siren not triggered: at the baseline only on heartbeat loss (after 5 s, for 3 s; main.c:193-205). TSR-516 v0.3 adds every envelope revocation that is not a driver action (incl. EPS fault, TSR-110) and a fault-induced disengagement whose ACC cancel had no effect . EPS fault: siren once the fault has persisted 0.7 s while engaged (panda bf8102a, DQ-048; 1 s at b790fca), ≤ 0.96 s after onset worst case, within the 1 s budget (WP-S-04 T-28; not verified on hardware). 2026-10-13: siren when heartbeat loss revokes granted authority, ≈ 0.56 s after the last heartbeat, all builds (panda c33343b; WP-S-04 T-07a). Since DQ-404 A the command-arrival revocation sounds it 0.25 s after a SoC stall (WP-S-04 T-34). Since panda f4803c5 (TSR-516(c)) it sounds when PCM cruise is still active 0.5 s after a "not engaged" heartbeat (selfdrived stop, BE-2.21). Latent tag kept for these three causes until verified on hardware (OI-11). Not implemented: the (b) triggers on an RX fault, a rejected command (TSR-108 does not revoke), a TX failure or bus-off, and a platform fault) → SWF-092: Panda siren not sounded when the panda revokes granted authority after the host stops; worst cause SWF-092.C1 (Defect in the panda siren starts (heartbeat_siren.h, engaged_mismatch.h, main.c; panda c33343b, 8a69ccf, f4803c5): the start input not set on a revocation that removed granted authority, the 0.5 s mismatch siren not started while cruise stays on, or a siren on an ordinary disengagement that drops cruise within 0.5 s; O 3, D 4, AP L); detection: tests/heartbeat_siren and tests/engaged_mismatch host tests (siren at 0.5 s in a stall, silent on a cancel, no siren after a cruise drop), run by the safety.yaml panda host tests job; HIL test_15 and test_16 confirm the siren by ear on the bench only (no rating credit) BE-2.15 (Siren silenced with the SoC audio (shared codec or amplifier, unknown topology)) → DFM-017: No SoC-independent warning on SoC loss; worst cause DFM-017.C1 (Siren shares the codec, amplifier or speaker with the SoC audio, which the faulty SoC powers down; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-2.22 (Siren path fault (driver, amplifier or speaker) latent: no siren self-test (DFM-017.C2; DFM-ACT-011) (random HW)) → DFM-017: No SoC-independent warning on SoC loss; worst cause DFM-017.C1 (Siren shares the codec, amplifier or speaker with the SoC audio, which the faulty SoC powers down; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-2.16 (Cluster cruise indicator unchanged (no ACC cancel on the fault, TSR-303) or not independent (AOU-12)) → SFM-021, SWF-048, SWF-039, SFM-028: Stock cruise stays engaged after LionDriver disengages; worst cause SFM-028.C1 (UI renders stale selfdriveState; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.02 (Envelope blocks or revokes authority while the SoC shows engaged (RX fault, stuck authority, safety-mode mismatch; HE-02.4)) → SWF-021, SWF-027, SWF-019, SWF-047, DFM-009: Heartbeat gap longer than the 0.3 s panda budget while engaged; worst cause SWF-047.C1 (controlsd raises on input it does not guard and exits; the 100 Hz loop has no exception handling. The example of BL-004, int(NaN) when lateralDelay is not finite (latcontrol_torque.py:100), is guarded since #51 (falls back to steerActuatorDelay, controlsd.py:158-160); other inputs are not; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No test injects non-finite lateralDelay BE-2.09 (Envelope blocking detected by controlsMismatch after ≈2 s or not at all if pandaStates is stale with authority shown. BL-005: controlsMismatch after 2 samples, ≤ 0.5 s (TSR-621, selfdrived.py:361-366); not re-rated) → SWF-034, SWF-032: Panda/host disagreement on safety mode or controls-allowed detected late or not at all; worst cause SWF-032.C1 (Panda fault flags other than relayMalfunction get no reaction in selfdrived (pandaStates.faults: interruptRate*, heartbeatLoopWatchdog, registerDivergent, ...), and SPI error bursts are not supervised (IA host-supervision OI-2). At BL-004 heartbeatLost, safetyTxBlocked and txRateExceeded were not read either; since #51 they are (pandaTxRateExceeded, pandaHeartbeatLost, pandaTxBlocked, immediate disable; selfdrived.py:367-375, TSR-615). The EPS-fault flag is covered by the EPS status events from card; O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: test_supervision.py tests TxBlockedMonitor (baseline, rise while engaged, panda reset); nothing tests the other fault bits BE-2.03 (Input of the lateral control law lost or stale (modelV2, calibration, carState) and control continues on it (GAP-16)) → SWF-043, SWF-073: Lateral and longitudinal commands computed from stale or frozen model and planner outputs; worst cause SWF-043.C2 (selfdrived suppresses commIssue while the big model is loading or settling (selfdrived.py:391-393), so held modelV2 got no reaction for that window at BL-004. Since #51 the controlsd freshness gate stops lateral actuation on a modelV2 more than 0.5 s old whatever selfdrived suppresses; the alert is still masked (TSR-603); O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: test_onroad TestChestnutOnroad needs device hardware; not run BE-2.10 (Input loss handled as soft disable: actuation continues ≈3 s (events.py:853-856, state.py:7-8; GAP-16)) → SWF-033: Disengagement later than the fault tolerance time; worst cause SWF-033.C2 (Every timer counts loop iterations, not time: soft_disable_timer (state.py:20, 40), mismatch_counter, cruise_mismatch_counter and the sm.frame gates (selfdrived.py:343, 423, 430). The loop is paced by the carState receive (20 ms timeout) with monitor_time only (selfdrived.py:85, 611-613) and does blocking Params writes (selfdrived.py:225, 311, 473), so when it slows, every timeout stretches (3 s soft disable is 6 s at 50 Hz); O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-1.20 (Diagnostics masked during big-model fallback (GAP-17; E-06 excluded from reference configuration)) → SWF-043: Lateral and longitudinal commands computed from stale or frozen model and planner outputs; worst cause SWF-043.C2 (selfdrived suppresses commIssue while the big model is loading or settling (selfdrived.py:391-393), so held modelV2 got no reaction for that window at BL-004. Since #51 the controlsd freshness gate stops lateral actuation on a modelV2 more than 0.5 s old whatever selfdrived suppresses; the alert is still masked (TSR-603); O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: test_onroad TestChestnutOnroad needs device hardware; not run

svg.text: SG-02: 27 events (backed 25, by design 1, external 3, unbacked 0); 38 FMEA modes reach SG-02 (in the tree 36, justified 2, tree gaps 0)
Worst cause: highest AP, then highest D. Red: single-point path from the gate logic. Text cut with … is given in full in the figure description.
